submission.bindingBasis: No expectedSourceStateDigest binding is required because workspace.close may omit the expectedSourceStateDigest, and the planning evidence indicates the Workspace was clean and ready to close with no unreviewed local work.
submission.rationale: The intended consequence is to close the Workspace and release its local materialization. The owner action contract permits workspace.close with an omitted expectedSourceStateDigest (an unbound close). The planning evidence confirms the Workspace was observed clean with no unreviewed local work and was judged ready to close. Since the close can proceed without a CAS (compare-and-swap) guard, there is no need to bind to a specific sourceStateDigest or reobserve. Acting unbound avoids the risk of a false or overwrite consequence and directly fulfills the intended close.
